correctness.rationale: Equality-graph connected components give q^{-(v-c)} exactly; two disjoint mirror matchings at distinct centers form a forest by nonzero translation; k<=3 constraint graphs are subgraphs of parity paths. At k>=4 three consecutive starts have graph rank 2floor(k/2)+1 and nonzero triple cumulant. Pairwise independence and nonnegative triple cumulants imply exact moments and non-binomiality. Rigidity follows from Cauchy-Schwarz on s_2 and s_3. A standalone standard-library exact verifier passed 2931 assertions and finite translated-triple offset enumeration; all-size proofs given in RESULT.md.

value.rationale: For palindromic match counts, the full indexed dependence and pairwise-independent/non-binomial distinction are central to testing and calibrating occurrence statistics. The all-subset graph formula determines exact local interactions without brute-force word enumeration, the k=4 cutoff locates first hidden dependence, and nonuniform rigidity identifies the modeling boundary; the genuine dependence structure is not exposed by mean and variance alone.
